component.name: Jiyue
component.summary: Local-first Markdown notes app with live preview, CJK search and S3 sync

description.p: Jiyue is a local-first Markdown note-taking app built with Rust and GPUI. Your notes stay as plain Markdown files in normal folders on your disk, with live preview, wikilinks, backlinks, knowledge graph, full-text CJK/English search, local version history, and S3/WebDAV sync.

screenshot.caption: Live preview with tables, callouts, sidebar and outline panel
